profile.headline: Neo-renaissance man
profile.summary:
A high tech developer with broad experience culled throughout a varied career that started in the video game industry as a Producer and has transitioned into a full-time Software Engineer for consumer video products.

A highly creative, technical mind with a diverse background and an exceptional ability to communicate across all disciplines including Engineering, Art, Game Design, Marketing, QA, Finance and Project Management.

Specialties: Video game production, Wii, Playstation, XBox, PC, team management & presentations, Agile project management, Hansoft, ScrumDesk, DevTrack, Perforce, SVN, MySQL, PHP, Flash CS4, Actionscript 3.0, OOP, Visual Studio, C#, SQL, Haxe, Java, C++, Android development

positions.title: Co-Founder/Software Developer
positions.description: An independent developer of an intellectual property related to man’s future in space encompassing all forms of media including video games, social web games & motion pictures. I write the code that inspires the world to start the dream of Star Trek for mankind.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Software Engineer on client team implementing the next generation High Definition software release for TiVo DVR & streamer platforms using Haxe, C++ and Java. Expertise in UI implementation, client-server communication and software design.

positions.title: Independent Contractor - Software Engineer
positions.description: Self-employed Flash Developer, specializing in web games using Flash CS5, Actionscript 3.0 and PHP. Clients included UbiSoft and Zerom Games working on casual social games targeted for MySpace and Facebook.

positions.title: Lead Producer
positions.description:
Produced and shipped the following titles:
* SimAnimals: Africa - Wii (Lead)
* SimAnimals - Wii (Lead)
* The Sims 2: Castaway - PS2, Wii (Lead)
* The Sims 2: Pets - PS2, NGC, Wii
* The Sims 2 - PS2, NGC, Xbox
* The Urbz: Sims in the City - PS2, NGC, Xbox
* The Sims: Bustin' Out - PS2, NGC, Xbox

positions.title: Consulting Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed and developed a 3D arcade-type space game prototype. Worked with CEO to develop the title to a playable state for presentations. Project included parameterized asteroid model generation using external applications to create unique in-game models and textures.

positions.title: Senior Producer
positions.description:
Production for:
* "Crawl" - D & D Online
* Master Tools
* Magic: Online
* Magic: The Gathering Starter CDROM - multiple languages

positions.title: Program Manager
positions.description: Designed and managed development of an online directory and search feature for a B2B portal site targeted to small businesses.

positions.title: Producer
positions.description: Managed an existing 13 person development team to produce "Babylon 5: Into The Fire", a 3D space simulation action game for Windows PCs. Reviewed and restructured project schedule to validate development plan.

positions.title: Producer
positions.description: Assembled and managed a team of 10 to develop a 3D platform game "Control Freak" using Surreal Software's Riot Engine. Budgeted production resources while completing R&D and pre-production on the concept.

positions.title: Associate Producer
positions.description:
Produced and shipped the following titles:
* Streets of SimCity - Windows
* SimCity Classic Collection 3 - Windows, Mac
* A-Train - Sony PlayStation
* SimCity 2000 - Sega Saturn (also Art Director), Sony PlayStation

Designer for:
* SimBusiness
* SimBot (also Art Director)

positions.title: Art Director
positions.description: Managed a small art team to develop the look and style for SimBOT, a 3D battlemech simulation game tied to SimCity 2000. Worked in 3D Studio and traditional media to create concepts, storyboards and preliminary 3D models.
